stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). Test-optional: 23% of enrolled first-year students submitted SAT scores (1,054 students) and 2.6% ACT (118). The CDS leaves the waitlist 'accepted a place' row blank (2,584 offered a place, 711 admitted); re-read on the rendered page 2026-11-03, the 711 sits in the 'wait-listed students admitted' row. Delaware also left the accepted row blank in its 2024-25 CDS (3,417 offered, 2,087 admitted) and 2023-24 CDS (2,741 offered, 121 admitted), so the yearly admitted counts swing widely. No early decision; early action is offered (CDS C21/C22). Average GPA 3.90 is for the 98% who reported one.

cost.notes: First-year full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1 asks for 2026-27; amounts match UD's own 2026-27 international rates page): in-state tuition $15,740, non-resident tuition $42,470, required fees $2,550 (the international page shows $2,930 mandatory fees for international students, which includes a $380 International Student Service fee), on-campus housing $9,286 plus meal plan $7,328. Estimated expenses (residents): books $1,250, transportation $1,000, other $2,000 (other shown = transportation + other). UD's international page also lists a $260 new-student orientation fee and $3,888 medical insurance, and totals $70,412 a year for a non-resident international student; differential charges apply to Business, Engineering, Nursing, Honors and Music.
